Package it.polimi.ingsw.model.shared.card

Class BasicCard

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.model.shared.card.BasicCard
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
Direct Known Subclasses:
GoldCard
public class BasicCard extends Object implements Serializable
Represents a side of the simplest card in the game, namely resource cards and starter cards. Each side has its related card's unique ID, a color and sometimes a points number; it also stores its associated corners. The resources attribute refers only to the resources found in the center of the side, not in the corners: it's treated as a list because some sided have more than one symbol. When the related card is drawn during a game, the player that owns it is also saved in this class.
